data.gender_notes: Sahanur is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who is calm and peaceful
data.long_meaning: Sahana means calm and ur means body, thus Sahanur is one who is calm and peaceful in their nature. The name Sahanur carries the meaning “One who is calm and peaceful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sahanur usually hope their child will grow to embody one who is calm and peaceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Sahanur belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who is calm and peaceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sahanur total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
